{
  "data": "@startuml
' Addendum authority: ADR-042; Study Focus affects supplementary practice only.
' Shared academic presentation; identities and authority belong in comments/index.
skinparam monochrome true
skinparam backgroundColor white
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam defaultFontName Arial
skinparam defaultFontSize 14
skinparam defaultFontColor black
skinparam titleFontSize 18
skinparam titleFontColor black
skinparam ArrowColor black
skinparam ArrowThickness 1
skinparam roundCorner 0
skinparam nodesep 35
skinparam ranksep 45
skinparam ActorBackgroundColor white
skinparam ActorBorderColor black
skinparam ParticipantBackgroundColor white
skinparam ParticipantBorderColor black
skinparam ControlBackgroundColor white
skinparam BoundaryBackgroundColor white
skinparam DatabaseBackgroundColor white
skinparam ClassBackgroundColor white
skinparam ClassBorderColor black
skinparam ClassHeaderBackgroundColor white
skinparam EntityBackgroundColor white
skinparam EntityBorderColor black
skinparam ActivityBackgroundColor white
skinparam ActivityBorderColor black
skinparam ActivityDiamondBackgroundColor white
skinparam ActivityDiamondBorderColor black
skinparam StateBackgroundColor white
skinparam StateBorderColor black
skinparam PackageBackgroundColor white
skinparam PackageBorderColor #555555
skinparam RectangleBackgroundColor white
skinparam RectangleBorderColor black
skinparam NoteBackgroundColor white
skinparam NoteBorderColor black
skinparam sequenceLifeLineBorderColor #555555
skinparam sequenceGroupBackgroundColor white
skinparam sequenceGroupBodyBackgroundColor white
' diagram-id: DATA-03
' classification: TARGET
' Logical identifiers/reference fields below are symbolic, not approved physical columns/keys.
' Authority ADR-030–036/041–043. Relation grouping and separate response/binding/history records
' express persistence requirements without mandating one SQL table per drawn entity.
title Sơ đồ quan hệ dữ liệu logic của Lingora
hide circle
skinparam nodesep 35
skinparam ranksep 50

 entity "AccountRecord" as Account {
  * accountIdentity
  --
  role; accountStatus
  locale; timezone; streak
 }
 entity "ContextRecord" as Context {
  * accountIdentity + learnedLanguage
  --
  status; purpose; studyPreferences
  studyFocus (mặc định BALANCED)
  startingPoint; provenance; selfReport
 }
 entity "LessonAttemptRecord" as Attempt {
  * attemptIdentity
  --
  contextRef; lessonRevisionRef
  contributionSum; responseCount
  completedAt
 }
 entity "ExerciseResponseRecord" as Response {
  * attemptRef + exerciseRef + responseOrder
  --
  firstOrRetry; contribution
 }
 entity "CompletionRecord" as Completion {
  * contextRef + lessonRef
  --
  completedAt; attemptProvenance
 }
 Account ||--o{ Context
 Context ||--o{ Attempt
 Attempt ||--o{ Response
 Context ||--o{ Completion
 Completion |o--|| Attempt : nguồn hoàn thành
 entity "CurriculumReference" as Curriculum {
  * curriculumPositionIdentity
  --
  language; framework; version
  level; course; unit
  ordering; eligibility
  finiteTopicSkillCatalog; controlledKnowledgeAreas
 }
 entity "LessonRecord" as Lesson {
  * lessonIdentity
  --
  curriculumRef; required; activeRevisionRef
 }
 entity "RevisionRecord" as Revision {
  * revisionIdentity
  --
  lessonRef; priorRevisionRef; lifecycle
  creatorRef; creationEpisodeRef
  exactSubmissionReviewRefs
  submissionActorAndEpisodeRefs
  concurrencyVersion
 }
 entity "ExerciseRecord" as Exercise {
  * revisionRef + exerciseIdentity
  --
  order; type; core
  practiceSkillRefs; immutableAreaSnapshot
  learnerPayload; protectedGradingData
 }
 entity "VocabularyRecord" as Vocabulary {
  * language + vocabularyIdentity
 }
 entity "LessonVocabularyLink" as LessonVocabulary {
  * revisionRef + vocabularyRef
  --
  coreOrOptional
 }
 Curriculum ||--o{ Lesson
 Lesson ||--o{ Revision
 Revision ||--o{ Exercise
 Revision ||--o{ LessonVocabulary
 Vocabulary ||--o{ LessonVocabulary
 entity "SrsCardRecord" as Card {
  * accountRef + vocabularyRef
  --
  enrollmentSource; stage; dueAt
 }
 entity "SrsOperationRecord" as Review {
  * reviewOperationIdentity
  --
  cardRef; selfRating; serverTime
  scheduleOutcome; idempotencyIdentity
 }
 Card ||--o{ Review
 entity "BlueprintRecord" as Blueprint {
  * blueprintIdentity
  --
  purpose; curriculumRef; coverage
  itemRequirements; assessmentConfiguration
 }
 entity "AssessmentVersionRecord" as Version {
  * assessmentVersionIdentity
  --
  blueprintRef; approvedSnapshot
  systemAssemblyInputRef; successorOfRef
  rubricSnapshot
 }
 entity "VersionItemRecord" as Item {
  * assessmentVersionRef + itemIdentity
  --
  contentSnapshot; protectedGradingData
  creatorRef; creationEpisodeRef
  sourceLessonRevisionRef; sourceSubmissionRef
  contributionEpisodeRef; secureOriginGuard
 }
 entity "AssessmentAttemptRecord" as AssessmentAttempt {
  * assessmentAttemptIdentity
  --
  contextRef; pinnedVersionRef
  purpose
  submissionIdentity
 }
 entity "AssessmentResultRecord" as Result {
  * assessmentAttemptRef
  --
  aggregateOutcome; recommendation
  assessmentType; deliveryMode; completedAt
 }
 entity "AssignmentRecord" as Assignment {
  * assignmentIdentity
  --
  lessonRef; currentTeacherRef; currentScopeRef
 }
 entity "AssignmentHistoryRecord" as History {
  * assignmentRef + episodeIdentity
  --
  previousTeacher; nextTeacher
  scopeSnapshot; episodeOrderAndBoundary
 }
 entity "SecurityAuditRecord" as Audit {
  * auditEventIdentity
  --
  actorRef; action
  targetVersionRef
  serverTime; outcome; reason
 }
 Blueprint ||--o{ Version
 Version ||--|{ Item
 Version ||--o{ AssessmentAttempt
 AssessmentAttempt ||--o| Result
 Assignment ||--o{ History
Account ||--o{ Card
Vocabulary ||--o{ Card
Context ||--o{ AssessmentAttempt
Lesson ||--o{ Assignment
Account ||--o{ Audit
Blueprint -[hidden]down- Account
Assignment -[hidden]right- Revision
' References without drawn joins: attempt→revision, completion→lesson, assignment→current Teacher.
' Revision creator/creationEpisode differs from exact source submission/submitter/episode.
' VersionItem sourceSubmissionRef pins retained actor/action/time/target/episode review history,
' distinct from SecurityAuditRecord; it must match sourceLessonRevisionRef and contributionEpisodeRef.
' Assessment contribution blueprint scope is checked through the source item, not a second Assignment target.
' Lesson–Vocabulary is the structural union/view; completion enrolls exact completed-revision core links.
' Version membership remains complete (one or more configured items); empty drafts are not assembled versions.
' CurriculumReference groups approved curriculum concepts; not a physical denormalization decision.
' Completion and latest completed performance remain distinct; history survives withdrawal/replacement.
' No Enrollment, persisted LearningPlan, SkillProfile or mastery store required.
@enduml
",
  "config": null
}
